name: Finished pirate ship modular art breakdown v3
purpose: Model and texture one corrected assembled ship, then derive coherent reusable parts from that master.

source.art_reference_role: Corrected appearance and composition master, not measured geometry. Numbered part sheets elaborate the separately modelable parts.
source.images_note: 00 and 02-04 are the .webp copies uploaded from the working folder, not the original PNGs; swap the originals in under the same names if the quality matters. 01 is rendered here by tools/render_textured.py.

fit_status.authority: Exact dimensions and boundary coordinates remain authoritative only for unchanged original canonical shell/floor interfaces. Read full socket boundaries from the source contract; this summary does not replace them.
fit_status.inherited_validation: Existing canonical validation applies only to its original construction geometry. It does not establish fit for this finished art breakdown.
fit_status.new_design_status: All new geometry, styling, cabin supports, rail replacements, apertures, rigging, accessories and their connections are proposed until modeled and checked.
checks_required_after_modeling: Canonical socket and protected join-band preservation
Assembled seam, silhouette and texture continuity
Open longitudinal interiors and valid exterior closures
Floor apertures, stairs, landings and support clearance
Rail post ownership and replacement-envelope fit
Cabin, gallery, mast, rudder and fitting attachments
Rigging endpoint connectivity and sail clearance

textured_construction_templates.scope: All 18 canonical parts, geometry byte-identical to canonical/meshes; UVs and a flat plank albedo added. No reshaping, bevels, trim or hardware.
textured_construction_templates.excluded: Finished decorative geometry, H11/H12, rails, cabin, apertures, rigging, hardware, collision and gameplay behaviour remain outside this proof.

art_master.workflow: Correct the whole ship first; derive every sheet and module from that same assembled design.
art_master.sails: Plain ivory cloth, subtle wear and repairs; no giant skull artwork on sails.
art_master.flag: Small separate black Jolly Roger flag, detached from sail and mast hardware.
art_master.mast_order: Shorter foremast forward; taller mainmast aft.
art_master.shown_sail_configuration: Two masts, two lower square sails, two topsails and one jib. M08 and S04 are optional aft-sail components, omitted from the assembled reduced-sail view. Their attachment is to M02, not a third mast.
art_master.mast_tops: Supported shallow mast tops with visible trestletrees, not unsupported deep baskets.
art_master.stern_lantern: Exterior stern lantern on a defined supporting bracket.
art_master.hull: Broad warm wooden planks and wooden wales; restrained local iron straps, fasteners and fittings; no giant iron hull cage.
art_master.coherence: Preserve one wood palette, bevel language, trim profile, plank scale and hardware scale across the whole ship.

coordinates.canonical_origin: Local fore station at tier base or floor top; X=0 centreline.
coordinates.new_object_origins: Declare an attachment datum and local orientation for each separately modelable object before export.

canonical_interface_summary.authority_scope: Unchanged original shell/floor interfaces only; not new parts or a dimensioned reconstruction of the artwork.
canonical_interface_summary.boundary_source: Use exact outer/inner outlines and complete socket point sets from the source contract.

assembly_rules: BOTTOM once at Y=0; zero, one or two complete MIDDLE tiers at 2.6 m pitch; TOP once. Do not stack another structural tier above TOP.
Extend length only by whole 2 m centre columns through every shell tier and floor level; keep bow/centre/stern plan outlines aligned per column.
Floors remain independent 0.18 m slabs. No posts, rails, curbs, wall remnants or fittings are baked into deck tiles.
The visible inner bottom planking of H02 is the once-only bilge hull skin, not an extra walkable deck. Keep it closed below; separate D-series deck slabs install above it.

Bow AFT and stern FORE longitudinal interfaces remain open across the ship interior; terminate the hull closed only at the actual prow and exterior stern. Do not add a full cut-face bulkhead across a mating opening.
Thin thickness caps belonging to individual canonical panel solids are not full interior bulkheads; preserve canonical boundaries when handling these during final assembly.
Keep all original socket points and the 0.10 m join bands unchanged; put bevels, plank relief and decorative trim outside those protected regions.
H05 gunports remain actual openings. H11 is a separate hinged lid, never a plug or permanent infill.

Railing assemblies replace the corresponding TOP envelope where used; never duplicate a full TOP wall with a complete railing assembly. Replacement connections and any changed envelope require new fit checks.
R02 owns railing posts. Place each seam post once; rail infill and shaped rails terminate at shared post sockets and do not duplicate posts.
Cabin, quarterdeck and galleries require continuous supported load paths into modeled beams or frames. Do not float or stack them on decorative rails.
Floor opening variants replace solid floor tiles; never overlay them. Keep matching apertures in every floor crossed by a mast or stair.
Mast shafts, supports, yards, rigging hardware, sails and flags remain separate objects. Cloth is never welded to mast hardware.
Every rope has named start and end attachments. Recompute or select rope lengths for each hull length and mast layout; do not universally stretch a completed rig.
Rotate or mirror only geometrically compatible parts, update attachment orientation and handedness, and correct UV orientation, grain, asymmetric wear and flag markings.

object_policy.components_within_one_id: Separately modelable objects, not welded together. Sets and variants describe grouping, not a fused mesh.
object_policy.variant_policy: Retain a shared interface only when modeled boundaries match; visual similarity does not prove interchangeability.

part_fit_status_values.canonical_interface_inherited_art_unveri: Source interface dimensions are retained; finished geometry and materials remain unmodeled and unverified.
part_fit_status_values.proposed_unmodeled: New design or connection, with no fit claim.
part_fit_status_values.canonical_opening_pair_art_unverified: Original START/END floor interfaces are retained; styling and any added clearance requirements need checking.
part_fit_status_values.tripo_extracted_unfitted: Cut from a Tripo sheet model: upright, real size, own texture. Not yet placed on the hull or checked for clearance.

materials.texel_density: Choose and record one project texel-density target before UV work; apply consistently across families. No numerical target is asserted here.
materials.grain: Use one real-world grain scale. Align deck grain longitudinally, hull grain along plank courses, and timber grain along each structural member.
materials.seams: Maintain matching plank course heights, wale profiles, UV phase and trim direction at repeatable boundaries.
materials.variation: Use compatible material or UV variants for wear without changing interface geometry or plank scale.
materials.mirror_caveat: Mirroring geometry does not authorize mirrored grain, lettering, flag art or baked directional shading; inspect and correct UVs and tangents.

attachment_naming.rope_values: Populate only after final assembled geometry exists; do not invent measured coordinates or lengths.

reference_reading_rules: Sheets are visual modeling/material references. Individual cells are framed independently and are not to one common pixel scale.
Measure inherited interfaces from canonical-contract.json, not from perspective art or decorative bevels.
The corrected assembled image shows appearance, not a verified assembly of these future meshes.
Part IDs group variants and removable objects; 57 IDs do not mean 57 fused meshes.
New accessories, deck holes, cabin, railings and rig require actual modeling and assembled clearance validation before use.
Optional M08/S04 are supplied as separate design options and are omitted in the assembled reduced-sail view.

01-hull-modules.png supersedes the painted hull sheet (kept as drafts/01-hull-modules-painted.webp): it renders the exact construction meshes with their albedo. The painted sheet remains the only picture of H11 and H12, which stay separate unmodelled fittings. Other sheets guide styling, not measured geometry.
